notes: The IDLE primitive of NP_04 s2 as data: every verb the 24 patterns' IDLE lines use (52 lines, 41 verbs) with the mechanic the sim runs between strings - how he closes (the speed, whether he leads your movement), the range he keeps, how he circles or holds it, the guard he holds when he has not read your punch, the clocks he taunts or shifts tempo on, and three flags only the presentation reads. A line is 'verb' or 'verb@Ns' (the clock's seconds). The neutral game runs in IDLE and RECOVER; in a TELL he closes to 1.9m at his own pace. A pattern with no IDLE lines (the generics) keeps the default below, which is the pre-PAC-071 approach exactly. Every speed, range, rate and clock value is a first-draft design value read off the roster docs' words; the guard's wobble_mult halves an authored guard when the boss is wobbled (NP_03 s3: 'the opponent's cue to swarm') except where it is composed.

circle_slow.line: Yuri: closes, then circles slow at range, one way round

circle_fast.line: Carter: the crossover - closes and circles fast, the other way round

lateral_drift.line: Vane: drifts side to side outside your reach and lets the corner call it

lateral_orbit.line: Marta: orbits at her range, and steps back out to it

survey_orbit.line: The Cartographer: surveys the whole ring from long range, turning back every 3s

textbook_orbit.line: Sora: the textbook circle at the textbook range, reversing every 4s

professor_orbit.line: Baro: circles at lecture distance and changes direction after every string

forward_walk_slow.line: Moira: the sea doesn't chase - it walks

forward_walk_glacial.line: Jean-Guy / Remy: the glacial walk, the footwork that never changes

dead_stance.line: The Echo: no ideas of its own - straight at your position, never at where you are going

advance_patient.line: Osei: shell up, patient, stops just outside your reach

advance_noiseless.line: Choir: the shared approach with the footwork audio stripped

crowding_advance.line: Alfie: crowds in - his range is inside yours

perpetual_advance.line: Deshawn: never stops coming - always mid-string, always closer

advance_metronome.line: Ada: a step forward on every beat of her metronome and still between

dual_tempo_advance.line: Chiamaka: a step on each of her two tempos

angle_walk.line: Tam: approaches on the angle, switching sides every 1.5s - never down the middle

neutral_stance_studied.line: Vey: studies you - at range he mirrors your lateral movement step for step

measured_stance.line: Vasile: holds his measured range both ways - steps in when you leave it, steps back when you enter it

charter_stance.line: Cal: holds the centre - he stands on it while you are within his 2.2m of it, and otherwise takes the centre-side spot 2.2m from you: he comes no closer, you come the rest

herding_bias_ropes.line: Moira: she approaches from the centre side - the ring is cut, your back goes to the ropes

taunt.line: Yuri / Carter: a taunt on his clock (taunt@Ns) - his guard is open 500ms and his next string waits 700ms

no_taunt.line: Vane: the taunt clock declared off - she never taunts

tempo_shift.line: Tam: every N s (tempo_shift@Ns) his between-strings tempo flips - slow (recover x1.4, walk x0.7) to fast (x0.6, x1.3) and back

guard_mid.line: the baseline guard, head and body alike

guard_high.line: a high guard: the head covered, the body open

guard_tight.line: Ada: the academy guard, tight everywhere

guard_rough.line: Alfie: ugly on purpose - the guard is rough

guard_composed.line: Cal / Surety: the guard does not drop when he is hurt

guard_advance.line: Sam: the guard is up while he walks in

guard_perfect.line: Sora: every value at the top of the fair range

guard_low_bait.line: Tam: the hands low - the body covered, the head offered

shell_stance.line: Osei: the shell - head shots skate off it, body work cracks it

silent.line: Jean-Guy: no sound from his feet - a flag the presentation reads

footwork_audio_drops_when_arming.line: Marta: her footwork goes quiet while she arms (TELL / HOLD / FAKE) - a flag the presentation reads

bell_in_corner.line: Reyes: she rings her corner's bell at the bell; with a Reyes in your stable, two bells (an event the presentation plays)

unmasked.line: Remy: the only syndicate fighter who shows his face - in a blind dual his slot is named at the corner where every other shows '?'
